### Celex Case Id
39824_6567_14

### Case Title
AT.39824–Trucks

### Overview
The case involves a cartel in the truck industry, specifically focusing on Scania AB (publ), Scania CV AB (publ), and Scania Deutschland GmbH. The cartel period spans from 1997-01-17 to 2011-01-18, with collusion on pricing and gross price increases for medium and heavy trucks, as well as the timing and passing on of costs for emission technologies. Key events include meetings, price increases, and a final top management meeting in 2004. The European Commission initiated proceedings in 2014 and adopted a settlement decision in 2016. The infringement category is horizontal, and the subcategory involves exchange of information on prices and sales. The companies involved are all based in Sweden and Germany, and the case is related to the manufacture of motor vehicles (NACE code 29.10). The Commission ordered the companies to end the infringement, refrain from repeating the infringing conduct, and comply with Article 1 of the Decision.
